environment.description: Same application deployed behind an Istio service mesh ingress gateway (envoy-based) with a PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace. The Gateway resource specifies tls.mode=MUTUAL with credentialName referencing a Kubernetes secret containing the CA bundle (corp-client-ca). The DestinationRule for the service enforces trafficPolicy.tls.mode=ISTIO_MUTUAL. Additionally, the EnvoyFilter resource on the gateway workload has a custom Lua filter that normalizes Transfer-Encoding headers and rejects requests containing both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length headers simultaneously (returning 400). The PeerAuthentication STRICT mode means the Envoy sidecar will reject any connection that does not present a valid SPIFFE-based client certificate issued by the mesh CA (istiod). External clients without mesh identity certificates cannot establish a TCP connection to the pod at all - the TLS handshake fails before any HTTP parsing occurs.

config.external_access: requires valid mesh-issued client cert (X.509 SVID)
